title: DoubleCheck
tagline: ROS Robot to double check orders for shipping, releasing escrow when shipping is successful
description:
use ROS to send camera images to AI models, accompanied with product description, 
AI decides if description matches product, hopefully enhancing customer trust and satisfaction
ROS node then if able to ship the product
takes further decision, of releases escrow, updating shipping info on the chain, etc
how_its_made:
ROS node for simple arm control, and camera using gazebo plugin
ollama 3.2 model to accept still images of product and text and images from description
use autonome to run inference on decentralized models to guarantee model impartial evaluation of matching between customer order, product description and exact status of the actual product shipped
